scanNote:
11-UNITNING BIRINChI BETI (76-bet) - LEAD-IN. Och ko'k fon.

Chap yuqorida qora 'UNIT 11', SARIQ bo'rtma harflar 'Our Precious Planet'.

OLTI SURAT (raqamli): 1 - yashil o'rmon va daryo (tropik o'rmon); 2 - qizil ikki qavatli London avtobusi (jamoat transporti); 3 - o'tloqda bug'u va bolasi (yovvoyi tabiat); 4 - tirband ko'cha, mashinalar tutuni (car fumes); 5 - shlyapali erkak miltiq bilan nishonga olmoqda (ovchi); 6 - ko'k ko'ylakli erkak belkurak bilan daraxt ekmoqda, yonida aravacha.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Lead-in'.
1) 1 'Look at the pictures. Which picture shows: car fumes; public transport; a rainforest; a person planting a tree; a hunter; wildlife?' (katakchalar)
   2 a) 'What is acid rain? Tick (✓).' light rain / rain with chemicals from factories. b) 'What can cause acid rain? Tick (✓).' rainforests? pollution? animals?
   3 a) 'Which of the following are endangered species? Tick (✓).' tigers, lions, dogs, seals, rhinos. b) "Why do we call them 'endangered' species?"
2) 'Match the problems to the causes, then make sentences using the passive, as in the example. Can you think of any other causes of these problems?' YaShIL QUTILAR: Problems: endangered species/kill; air pollution/cause; rainforests/destroy | Causes: cars; hunters; logging companies. (1-band 'hunters' ga strelka bilan bog'langan) Ko'k qiya: 'Endangered species are killed by hunters.'
3) 'The list below includes possible solutions to the problems mentioned above. Use the phrases to make sentences, as in the examples.' Qiya: use bicycles, plant new trees, drive electric cars, use less paper, create special parks for animals, teach hunters it's wrong to kill animals. Ko'k qiya namunalar (o'ng ustunda): 'If we USED bicycles, we WOULD HAVE less air pollution.' / 'If we PLANTED new trees, rainforests WOULDN'T DISAPPEAR.' / 'If we CREATED special parks for animals, they WOULDN'T be in danger.'

O'NG USTUN:
4) Kasseta belgisi: 'Match the speakers to what each one would do if he/she was leader of his/her country. Write R for Roberta, M for Maria or J for James.' 1 stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest 2 not allow hunters to kill endangered species 3 ban cars 4 create special parks 5 improve public transport 6 make logging companies plant new trees

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '76'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures. Which picture shows: car fumes; public transport; a rainforest; a person planting a tree; a hunter; wildlife?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang. Qaysi surat ko'rsatadi: mashina tutuni; jamoat transporti; tropik o'rmon; daraxt ekayotgan odam; ovchi; yovvoyi tabiat?
exercises.explanationUz:
OLTI SURAT - OLTI TUShUNChA.

  car fumes → 4 (tirband ko'cha)
  public transport → 2 (avtobus)
  a rainforest → 1 (o'rmon)
  a person planting a tree → 6
  a hunter → 5 (miltiq)
  wildlife → 3 (bug'ular)


⚠ 'FUMES':

  = tutun, zaharli gaz.
  ⚠ HAR DOIM ko'plikda.
  ⚠ 'car fumes' = mashina tutuni.


⚠ 'PUBLIC TRANSPORT':

  = jamoat transporti.
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'WILDLIFE':

  = yovvoyi tabiat (hayvonlar).
  ⚠ SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'PRECIOUS':

  = qimmatli, aziz.
  ⚠ 'Our Precious Planet' - unit
  nomi (68-betdagi muqovada).

exercises.instructionEn: a) What is acid rain? Tick (✓). b) What can cause acid rain? Tick (✓).
exercises.instructionUz: a) Kislotali yomg'ir nima? Belgilang. b) Kislotali yomg'irga nima sabab bo'lishi mumkin? Belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'ACID RAIN':

  = kislotali yomg'ir.
  ⚠ Zavodlar va mashinalar tutunidagi
  kimyoviy moddalar yomg'ir bilan
  tushadi - o'rmon va ko'llarga zarar.
  ⚠ 'acid' o'qilishi /ˈæsɪd/.


⚠ 'CHEMICALS':

  = kimyoviy moddalar.
  ⚠ 'ch' → /k/: /ˈkemɪklz/.


⚠ 'A FACTORY':

  = zavod, fabrika.
  ⚠ Ko'pligi 'factorIES'.

items.textEn: b) What can cause acid rain?

exercises.instructionEn: a) Which of the following are endangered species? Tick (✓). b) Why do we call them 'endangered' species?
exercises.instructionUz: a) Quyidagilardan qaysilari yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi turlar? Belgilang. b) Nega ularni 'endangered' turlar deymiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'ENDANGERED SPECIES':

  = yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi
  turlar.
  ⚠ 'endangered' = xavf ostida
  ('en-' + 'danger' + '-ed').
  ⚠ 'species' - birlik = ko'plik.


JAVOB: tigers, lions, seals, rhinos
  ✓ (dogs ✗ - itlar ko'p).


b) Nega 'endangered'?
  Chunki ular soni juda kamaygan va
  butunlay yo'qolib ketishi mumkin
  ('in danger of dying out').


⚠ 'A SEAL':

  = tyulen.
  ⚠ 'seal' = muhr ham.


⚠ 'A RHINO':

  = karkidon ('rhinoceros'
  qisqartmasi).

items.textEn: b) Why do we call them 'endangered' species?
options: Because they are in danger of dying out completely.
Because they are dangerous to people.
items.answer: Because they are in danger of dying out completely.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the problems to the causes, then make sentences using the passive, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Muammolarni sabablarga moslang, so'ng majhul nisbatda gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
MUAMMO → SABAB:

  endangered species/kill → hunters
    (kitobda strelka bilan)
  air pollution/cause → cars
  rainforests/destroy → logging
    companies

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'Endangered species are killed by
   hunters.'


⚠ MAJHUL NISBAT (9-unit):
  are killed BY hunters
  is caused BY cars
  are destroyed BY logging companies


⚠ 'A LOGGING COMPANY':

  = yog'och tayyorlash kompaniyasi
  (daraxt kesadi).
  ⚠ 'a log' = xoda, to'nka.


⚠ BOShQA SABABLAR (savol):

  air pollution → factories,
     aeroplanes
  rainforests → fires, farmers
  endangered species → pollution,
     loss of habitat

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda strelka bilan: 'Endangered species are
killed by hunters.'

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using the passive, as in the example. Can you think of any other causes of these problems?
exercises.instructionUz: Majhul nisbatda gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. Bu muammolarning boshqa sabablarini o'ylab topa olasizmi?
exercises.exampleEn: Endangered species are killed by hunters.
exercises.exampleUz: Xavf ostidagi turlar ovchilar tomonidan o'ldiriladi.
modelAnswers: Endangered species are killed by hunters.
Air pollution is caused by cars.
Rainforests are destroyed by logging companies.
Air pollution is also caused by factories.
Rainforests are also destroyed by fires.
modelAnswersUz: Xavf ostidagi turlar ovchilar tomonidan o'ldiriladi.
Tropik o'rmonlar yog'och tayyorlash kompaniyalari tomonidan vayron qilinadi.
Havo ifloslanishiga zavodlar ham sabab bo'ladi.
Tropik o'rmonlarni yong'inlar ham vayron qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: The list below includes possible solutions to the problems mentioned above. Use the phrases to make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatda yuqoridagi muammolarning mumkin bo'lgan yechimlari bor. Iboralardan foydalanib namunalardagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:

  'If we USED bicycles, we WOULD HAVE
   less air pollution.'
  'If we PLANTED new trees,
   rainforests WOULDN'T DISAPPEAR.'
  'If we CREATED special parks for
   animals, they WOULDN'T be in
   danger.'


⚠ 2-TUR ShART GAPLARI (11-unit
  grammatikasi):

  If + PAST SIMPLE, would + fe'l
  ⚠ XAYoLIY vaziyat (hozir shunday
  emas).
  ⚠ 'If we used bicycles' - hozir
  ishlatmaymiz, lekin AGAR ...


YEChIMLAR:

  use bicycles - velosiped
     ishlatmoq
  plant new trees - yangi daraxt
     ekmoq
  drive electric cars - elektr
     mashina haydamoq
  use less paper - kamroq qog'oz
     ishlatmoq
  create special parks for animals -
     hayvonlar uchun maxsus parklar
     yaratmoq
  teach hunters it's wrong to kill
     animals - ovchilarga hayvon
     o'ldirish noto'g'riligini
     o'rgatmoq


⚠ 'LESS':

  = kamroq (sanalmaydigan bilan).
  ⚠ 'less pollution', 'less paper'.
  ⚠ Sanaladigan bilan 'fewer'.
exercises.exampleEn: If we used bicycles, we would have less air pollution.
exercises.exampleUz: Agar velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi kamroq bo'lardi.
modelAnswers: If we used bicycles, we would have less air pollution.
If we planted new trees, rainforests wouldn't disappear.
If we drove electric cars, there would be less air pollution.
If we used less paper, fewer trees would be cut down.
If we created special parks for animals, they wouldn't be in danger.
If we taught hunters it's wrong to kill animals, endangered species would survive.
modelAnswersUz: Agar velosiped ishlatsak, havo ifloslanishi kamroq bo'lardi.
Agar yangi daraxtlar eksak, tropik o'rmonlar yo'qolmasdi.
Agar elektr mashina haydasak, havo ifloslanishi kamroq bo'lardi.
Agar kamroq qog'oz ishlatsak, kamroq daraxt kesilardi.
Agar hayvonlar uchun maxsus parklar yaratsak, ular xavfda bo'lmasdi.
Agar ovchilarga hayvon o'ldirish noto'g'riligini o'rgatsak, xavf ostidagi turlar saqlanib qolardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the speakers to what each one would do if he/she was leader of his/her country. Write R for Roberta, M for Maria or J for James.
exercises.instructionUz: Gapiruvchilarni har biri o'z mamlakati rahbari bo'lsa nima qilishiga moslang. Roberta uchun R, Maria uchun M, James uchun J yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio bor, lekin javoblar 77-BETDAGI
MATNLARDA (5-mashq).

  Roberta (Italiya): 3 ban cars,
     5 improve public transport
  James (Keniya): 2 not allow hunters,
     4 create special parks
  Maria (Braziliya): 1 stop logging
     companies, 6 make them plant
     new trees


OLTI ChORA:

  1 stop logging companies from
    destroying the rainforest
  2 not allow hunters to kill
    endangered species
  3 ban cars
  4 create special parks
  5 improve public transport
  6 make logging companies plant new
    trees

  ⚠ Har gapiruvchi 2 tadan chora
  aytsa kerak (mavzu bo'yicha:
  o'rmon 1+6, hayvonlar 2+4,
  transport 3+5).


⚠ 'IF HE/SHE WAS LEADER':

  2-tur shart: 'If I WAS leader, I
  WOULD ban cars.'
  ⚠ Rasmiy: 'If I WERE leader'.


⚠ 'TO BAN':

  = taqiqlamoq.
  ⚠ 'ban cars' = mashinalarni
  taqiqlamoq.


⚠ 'TO STOP SB FROM DOING':

  = kimnidir ... qilishdan
  to'xtatmoq.


⚠ 'TO MAKE SB DO':

  = majburlamoq ('to' siz).
  'make logging companies PLANT'.

pairs.left: 1 stop logging companies from destroying the rainforest
pairs.leftUz: yog'och kompaniyalarini o'rmonni vayron qilishdan to'xtatmoq
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 77-bet: Maria - 'I would stop logging
companies from destroying the rainforest'.

pairs.left: 2 not allow hunters to kill endangered species
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ James - "I wouldn't allow hunters to kill
endangered species".
⚠ James - 'I would also create special parks'.

⚠ Roberta - 'I would also improve public
transport'.

pairs.left: 6 make logging companies plant new trees
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Maria - 'make the logging companies plant
new trees'.
